steps.what: Show evidence already stored on the contested claim.
Collect evidence to support contested claims in court.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows evidence already on the contested claim. The claims adjuster collects the evidence that will support the claim in court. The screen does not create a fact, a photo, or a statement. A claim with no id leaves the collection with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A page was added to the court bundle from an empty note, and nobody had collected it.
tasks.enabler_now: Evidence already stored can be opened. Collecting what is still missing still belongs to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A fact no file holds still has to be collected by the adjuster, or left out.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster collects the evidence. The screen does not invent it.
tasks.altitude: Collection stays with the adjuster. Opening what is already stored is not the collection.

reach.learn: An empty note is not evidence.

evidence.claim: Opening evidence already stored is a lookup. It does not collect new evidence or support a claim in court.
A court bundle must not contain a fact, a photo, or a statement that nobody collected.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id and any evidence id already stored. The screen does not create evidence. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the evidence already on the file. Do not draft a fact that is not there.
unknowns: Whether photos, statements, and documents share one evidence record.
research_questions: Who confirms an item was collected for this contested claim?

already_counted.description: Collecting the evidence stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop evidence rows whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still collects the evidence to support the contested claim in court. Only opening evidence that was already stored is removed. The screen creates none of the evidence.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the claim before contact with the claimant.
Interview claimants, doctors, medical specialists, or employers.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the claim already stored. The claims adjuster contacts or interviews the claimant, the doctor, the medical specialist, or the employer to get additional information. The screen does not hold the interview and does not copy a medical note into a new record. A claim with no person named leaves the contact with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A medical note was copied into the file, and the doctor had not been interviewed.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored claim can be opened. The contact and the interview still have to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the person does not offer still has to be asked for, or left unknown.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster interviews. The screen does not copy medical information.
tasks.altitude: The interview stays with the adjuster and the person. The stored claim is only visible.

reach.task: Release a note only when this adjuster has a proper request.
reach.learn: A claim id is not a medical note.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored claim is a lookup. It does not contact or interview a claimant, a doctor, a specialist, or an employer.
Copying a medical note into a new record without the interview would store health information the adjuster did not obtain.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id already stored. The screen does not write a medical note or mark an interview done. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the claim before the contact. Do not copy a medical note.
unknowns: Whether claimant, doctor, and employer contacts share one note type.
research_questions: Who may record medical information from an interview, and where?

already_counted.description: The contact and the interview stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop claims whose file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still contacts or interviews the claimant, doctor, medical specialist, or employer. Only opening a claim that was already stored is removed. The screen does not copy a medical note or hold the interview.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the agenda line for this claim committee.
Present cases and participate in claim committee meetings.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the claim committee meeting already scheduled. The claims adjuster presents the case and participates in the discussion. The agenda line is not the presentation and does not decide the case. A meeting with no claim id leaves the presentation with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A case was marked discussed because it was on the agenda, and the adjuster had not presented it.
tasks.enabler_now: The agenda can be opened. The presentation and the discussion still have to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A question the agenda does not list still has to be answered in the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster presents and participates. The agenda is the list already stored.
tasks.altitude: The committee stays with the people in the meeting. The agenda line is only visible.

reach.task: Chair a committee this adjuster actually attends.
reach.learn: An agenda line is not the discussion.

evidence.claim: Opening an agenda is a lookup. It does not present a case or participate in the discussion.
Marking an agenda line complete is not the committee's decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The meeting id and the claim id already on the agenda. The screen does not record a decision. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the agenda before the meeting.
unknowns: Whether every committee case has a stored agenda line.
research_questions: Who records the committee's decision after the discussion?

already_counted.description: Presenting the case and joining the discussion stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop meetings whose claim has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still presents the case and still participates in the claim committee discussion. Only opening an agenda line that was already stored is removed. The agenda saves none of the meeting.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare stored amounts to find overpayments and underpayments.
Report other irregularities and accept the variance.

tasks.design: The {ERP} holds the amount paid and the amount entitled, both already stored. The variance is the difference, and a missing amount stops it. The claims adjuster reports other irregularities the subtraction cannot see, and accepts the variance. The screen does not invent a payment or recover one. Only the report the adjuster accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An overpayment was reported from a paid amount that had no entitled amount beside it.
tasks.enabler_now: Two stored amounts can be subtracted. The report, and any irregularity that is not a subtraction, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: An irregularity with no two amounts still has to be seen by the adjuster.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster accepts the variance and reports the other irregularities. The subtraction is not that judgement.
tasks.altitude: The report stays with the adjuster. It is filed only after that version is accepted, and it is not a payment.

reach.task: Use a variance this adjuster has accepted.
reach.learn: A single amount is not an overpayment.

evidence.claim: Subtracting a stored paid amount from a stored entitled amount is arithmetic. It does not report an irregularity or move money.
A missing amount is not a payment. Filing a variance before the adjuster accepts it would report a figure nobody checked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.

Fields: The paid amount and the entitled amount already stored. A missing amount stops the comparison. Other irregularities are not added by the subtraction. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Subtract the two stored amounts. Do not invent a payment, and do not recover one.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether overpayments and underpayments share one amount pair on the claim.
research_questions: Who confirms the entitled amount is the one in the policy, not a later estimate?

already_counted.description: Reporting irregularities and accepting the variance stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop amount pairs whose claim file has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: claim id, both amounts, and the report the adjuster accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still reports overpayments, underpayments, and other irregularities. Only subtracting a paid amount and an entitled amount that were both already stored, and filing the report already accepted, is removed. A missing amount saves none of that report, and no money moves.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The claims adjuster still collects the evidence, still interviews the person, still attends the committee, and still accepts the payment variance. A stored amount can be opened. It does not make those calls.
reach: Counsel receive evidence this adjuster collected, and a file is not the collection.
The committee hears the case from this adjuster, and an agenda line is not the presentation.
skills_to_grow: Collect evidence. Do not create a fact the file does not hold.
Interview the person. Do not copy a medical note into a new record.
Compare two stored amounts. Do not invent a payment.
role.ambitious_version: Evidence, interviews, the committee, and the variance judgement stay with the adjuster. Stored amounts only show figures already recorded.
